title: 65_HS1-101634279_100-DE-26505
doc_notes: This is an FBI investigative file regarding a civilian's report of a 1944 sighting in Germany, which contains detailed encounter information.

encounters.summary: Wladyslaw Krasuski, a former POW, reported observing a large circular vehicle in 1944 near Gut Alt Golssen, Germany, which rose vertically from an enclosure. He noted that tractor engines stalled in the area when a high-pitched whining noise was present.
encounters.entity_appearance: circular vehicle, 75-100 yards in diameter, 14 feet high, with a rapidly moving middle section
encounters.entity_behavior: rose vertically to clear a 50-foot wall and moved horizontally
encounters.quote: vehicle was observed to slowly rise vertically to a height sufficient to clear the wall
